name: Agent-First UI
synopsis: Let your AI agent hand you a real interface when a step needs a person — a window opens, values can stay live in both directions, and the session ends with one typed outcome.
intent: Host a Provider-owned Axum Router without interpreting its domain data or defining a shared domain UI protocol
Deliver a session through an isolated Chromium-family window, an AFUI-owned direct link, or a page served to a browser on another device
Carry typed live state, calls, progress, replies, ordered events, and bounded byte bodies through one reconnecting AFUI-owned session protocol
Route typed completion, window closure, and remote attention expiry to the exact waiting session while revoking credentials and cleaning up resources
mutations: Launch windows on a private page so the session credential is not in process arguments
Send no Referer from proxied pages and drop announced secrets from redirects
End streaming responses when their credential is revoked or expires
Redact credentials from Debug output on credentials, session entries and delivery facts
Carry the path-mode frame sandbox in a policy of its own
Route every session ending, including link lapses, through one completion slot
Refuse replays of evicted calls instead of running them again
Show images, tables and diffs as context in afui ask, and read requests from files
Serialize autosaves so overlapping saves no longer raise false conflicts
Give afui session commands their own error codes, including session_not_found
Make Error::InvalidUpstreamUrl fieldless and move to agent-first-data 0.36.0
